title: BoM: Relative Niño 3.4 Index at +2.72°C for Week Ending Sep 27
detail: Australia's Bureau of Meteorology reported the relative Niño 3.4 index at +2.72°C for the week ending 27 September 2026, well above the +0.8°C El Niño threshold, with further intensification forecast through spring.
